evidence.quote: The language of instruction is English, and applicants are required to submit proof of English language proficiency with their application.
Newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries have to pay tuition fees of 1,500 € per semester.
Higher education entrance qualification (i.e., Abitur, Fachhochschulreife, high school or other secondary education diploma).

notes: Duration: the DAAD page says "Programme duration 7 semesters"; the programme page states "7 Semester : Regular programme duration: 3.5 years" and "7 Semester : 210 ECTS", which give 3.5 years. Tuition: no programme-specific non-EU fee was quoted on the programme page (the programme page shows "Tuition fee : 0 €"); the 1,500 EUR/semester figure comes from the university's central tuition-fees pages and applies to newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries without a German university entrance qualification, so it does apply to this applicant, but the auditor should confirm. Intake: the pages state the deadline only as "July 15" without a year, so no date is given. applicationChannel: for a foreign-diploma applicant the pages require recognition of the certificate via Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist; the DAAD page says "the first step in applying to the BA International Business is to have your certificates recognised by the Studienkolleg – Center for International Students or uni-assist". Documents: the pages list no concrete document list for IB-E (only "Application Document Checklist"), so no documents fact is output.

note.fr: Votre diplôme étranger doit d'abord être reconnu par le Studienkolleg Konstanz ou uni-assist ; sans reconnaissance, la candidature ne sera pas examinée.
note.en: Your foreign certificate must first be recognised by Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist; without recognition your application will not be considered.

evidence.quote: If issued not in Germany, it first needs to be recognised by the Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist.
